definition.p_early_foul_trouble: P(2+ personal fouls by end Q1 (10:00) OR 3+ PF by end H1 (20:00)) -- the standard coaching in-foul-trouble heuristic
definition.minutes_at_risk: E[minutes lost to fouls] = max(0, mean(min|foul-OFF) - mean(min|foul-ON)) on the same seed stream (causal, foul channel only)
definition.minutes_lost_range: 10th-90th percentile of the per-simulation paired minutes difference. A SPREAD OF OUTCOMES, not a confidence interval, and it is wide on purpose -- the lower end sits at or below zero for most players, which is the true statement that fouls may cost them nothing tonight. Never narrow it for display.
definition.minutes_lost_sim_error: standard error of the MEAN only (simulation noise). Small. NOT the uncertainty in tonight's minutes -- do not show it as the range.
definition.thin_sample: true when the player's foul rate rests on few games or is mostly the positional league prior. Flags model uncertainty the ranges do NOT contain. Label the row; do not hide it.

card.title: Foul-Trouble Watch
card.hide_trivial: card_show=true when p_early_foul_trouble >= 0.10; lower-risk bench players are carried (card_show=false) but hidden by default
card.excluded_out: OUT / unavailable players were excluded upstream at sim time (absent from this feed by construction)
card.interval_rule: Every row carries minutes_lost_range and the card must render it. The range is wide and often opens at zero; that width is the finding, not a defect to be tidied away. Showing the midpoint alone would claim a precision this read does not have.

labels.league_avg_estimate: foul_rate_basis='league_avg_estimate' -> no real per-36 foul rate for this player; ran on a league-average foul-rate prior. Label the row as an estimate.
labels.player: foul_rate_basis='player' -> player's own per-36 foul rate (eb_foul_per36) used.
labels.thin_sample: thin_sample=true -> few games or heavy shrinkage behind the foul rate. Render a visible 'wide range' marker on the row.
